title: Screen flow fields: a date field is the browser's native input (mm/dd/yyyy under zh-CN), and a boolean is a bare checkbox under its label
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible defect — reach: public door, measured in a browser on the 18.1.0 Console with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main`, code read on objectstack `main` `1c632311`. **Reader:** the UI lane, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx` (`ScreenFieldInput`).

## Business reason
Record forms moved to the platform date picker (objectui#12622) and action dialogs, list filters and inline editors followed (objectui#12642, #12664, #12743, objectstack#25875). Flow screens did not. So the first form a new user meets in hotclm — the 发起合同 wizard — is the one that still looks unfinished.

## Measured (hotclm wizard step 「合同信息」, zh-CN)
1. **生效日期 / 到期日期** show `mm/dd/yyyy` with the browser's calendar icon. `ScreenView.tsx:546` maps `kind === 'date'` to `<Input type="date">`.
2. **金额为估算值** (and **立即提交** on the last step) render as the label on one line and a lone round checkbox on the next, with nothing beside it. It reads like an empty radio button. `ScreenView.tsx:540` draws a bare `<Checkbox>` under the generic `<Label>`. `ActionParamDialog` draws the same field type as an inline checkbox row with the label beside the control.

## Expected
- A `date` / `datetime` screen field uses the same platform picker as the record form, in the app locale's format.
- A `boolean` screen field uses the same inline row as `ActionParamDialog` (or the record form's switch), with the label beside the control.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recent, all states) and archived objectui issues grepped for `native`, `mm/dd`, `date picker`, `ScreenView`, `boolean` + `screen` — the date-picker series above lists record forms, action-param and bulk dialogs, inline editors and filters; none lists flow screens.

---
_Filed from the hotclm UI/UX review (2026-10-27); maintainer: 「平台的问题应该提交issue到平台」._
